lines.text: [cheerful, excited little child] आख़िरी ब्लॉक!
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] गोलू, मेरी बारी?
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] धड़ाम! धड़ाम!
[cheerful, excited little child] मेरा टावर गिर गया! उफ़्फ़!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] गुस्सा! गुस्सा!
[happy children cheering together] Golu is angry!
[happy children cheering together] Golu is angry!
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] सॉरी गोलू! ग़लती से गिर गया!
[happy children cheering together] रुको! साँस लो!
[happy children cheering together] रुको! साँस लो!
[happy children cheering together] Stop! Breathe!
[happy children cheering together] Stop! Breathe!
[cheerful, excited little child] फूल सूँघो...
[cheerful, excited little child] मोमबत्ती बुझाओ... फूँ!
[happy children cheering together] Smell the flower... blow the candle!
[happy children cheering together] Smell the flower... blow the candle!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] तुम भी! तुम भी!
[cheerful, excited little child] मुझे गुस्सा आया!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] Angry! Angry!
[cheerful, excited little child] गुस्सा आना ठीक है... फेंकना नहीं!
[happy children cheering together] Angry is okay. No throwing!
[happy children cheering together] Angry is okay. No throwing!
[cheerful, excited little child] कोई बात नहीं, बनी।
[sweet, soft, giggly little girl] चलो, साथ में बनाएँ!
[cheerful, excited little child] गुस्सा आए तो...
[cheerful, excited little child] रुको, साँस लो, बोलो!
[happy children cheering together] Stop, breathe, and say it!
[happy children cheering together] Stop, breathe, and say it!
[cheerful, excited little child] शाबाश! कल फिर मिलेंगे!
[squeaky, playful, fast little voice] See you tomorrow! Tomorrow!
